You are exploring the InkOS codebase (Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind 4).

Task: Catalogue every authenticated page under app/(app)/ and report HOW each one builds its top-of-page chrome (title, description, tabs, filter toolbar, primary CTA, right-side meta).

For each route, report:
- File path (with line ref to the header/top section)
- What component renders the title — PageHeader? Inline h1? Something bespoke?
- Whether there's a description subtitle and its spacing relative to the title
- Whether there's a tab/segmented-control row (view picker) and how it's rendered
- Whether there's a filter toolbar row (search + facet chips + columns button)
- Where the primary CTA ("+ New X") lives — inline with title? In toolbar row? Floating?
- Where the right-side meta lives (count like "1 of 1 client", last-synced, etc.)

Cover at minimum: /dashboard, /bookings, /bookings/new, /clients, /clients/[id], /consent-forms, /inventory, /inventory/stocktake, /guest-artists, /commissions, /payroll, /marketing, /ai-design, /payments, /reports (+ its 6 tabs), /settings/*.

Also look at:
- components/app/PageHeader.tsx (or wherever it lives)
- components/app/PageShell.tsx
- components/app/PageTabs.tsx  
- Any "toolbar", "filter-row", "view-switcher" components
- app/(app)/layout.tsx — what wraps every page? Does it inject consistent padding?

The user wants to standardize to a Shopify-admin-style structure:
Row 1: Title + description + right-side primary CTA + right-side secondary actions
Row 2 (optional): View tabs / saved views / segmented control
Row 3 (optional): Toolbar — search + filter chips + columns/sort/export

Report the divergence matrix. Which pages already match this? Which ones are bespoke? What's the rough count of each variant so we know the blast radius of standardizing?

Be concise but complete. Use markdown tables where useful. No fix proposals — just the inventory.
